summary: Supplier ledger code mismatch preventing automated payrun inclusion
description:
Issue summary:
A subset of vendor payouts scheduled for the 2026-03-01 automated weekly payrun were excluded during the payrun selection step. Root cause appears to be a mismatch between supplier ledger codes in the procurement system and the finance ledger mapping table used by the payrun scheduler.

Impact:
- 7 vendor invoices (value ~$48k) were not picked up by the automatic payrun and remained in 'Pending' state.
- Finance manually intervened to avoid missed payments; this increased operational load and risk of duplicate payments.
- Affects scheduled weekly automatic payrun for the US East region; no customer-facing outages but internal SLA missed.

Initial hypothesis:
Ledger mapping service returned a null mapping for a group of suppliers that were recently migrated from legacy vendor records. The payrun scheduler treats null/unknown ledger code as 'exclude' by design.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Use production DB snapshot (2026-03-01 02:00 UTC).
2) Query suppliers with vendor_origin = 'legacy_migration' and ledger_code IS NULL in ledger_mapping table.
3) Trigger payrun selection dry-run for weekly payrun for us-east.
4) Confirm those vendors are omitted from selection list and flagged 'mapping_missing'.
logs:
[2026-03-01T03:15:12Z] payrun-scheduler.INFO selecting vendors for weekly_us_east run_id=wr-2026-03-01
[2026-03-01T03:15:12Z] ledger-sync.WARN missing mapping for supplier_id=SV-9987 ledger_code=NULL
[2026-03-01T03:15:13Z] payrun-scheduler.INFO vendor SV-9987 excluded reason=mapping_missing
[2026-03-01T03:16:05Z] finance-ops.INFO manual_payment_created vendor=SV-9987 ref=MP-20260301-7
investigation_notes: Found 7 supplier records with ledger_code NULL in ledger_mapping; all have vendor_origin='legacy_migration' and recent vendor_id renames.

Ledger-sync job (daily at 00:30 UTC) showed errors for these supplier IDs between 2026-02-27 and 2026-02-28 — stack traces indicate unique constraint failure when writing to mapping table; job swallowed error and did not flag for re-run.
Payrun selection logic currently treats any non-resolvable mapping as exclusion. This is intended but means silent omissions if mapping sync fails.
Finance team confirmed manual payments were initiated on 2026-03-01 to avoid vendor impact; no duplicate payments observed so far but reconciliation pending.

Related PR in payrun-service attempts to make selection more verbose (https://github.com/redwood-inference/payrun-service/pull/1420) — aligns with this issue but does not address root mapping write failure.
comments: Hannah Li (Reporter) [2026-03-01]: Noticed 7 vendors missing from payrun snapshot; finance ops created manual payments. Please triage ledger-sync immediately.

Marcus Nguyen (Assignee) [2026-03-01]: Acknowledged. Pulling logs for ledger-sync and payrun dry-run.
Found the constraint failure traces; escalating to infra team for DB write retries.

Elena Park (Finance Ops) [2026-03-02]: Manual payments created and queued. Reconciliations team will compare against automated run once ledger mappings fixed.
Request: flag any future payruns with 'mapping_error' to be surfaced on the finance console.

DevInfra (by ticket) [2026-03-03]: Identified that the ledger_mapping table shard had reached 95% utilisation causing occasional write deadlocks; increased capacity and re-run ledger-sync for missed vendors.
Marcus Nguyen [2026-03-04]: Re-ran ledger-sync for the affected supplier list; mappings now present. Triggered payrun dry-run — vendors are included. Scheduling follow-up to harden error visibility.
Finance Ops [2026-03-05]: Confirmed vendors were successfully paid via manual run and will now be marked as reconciled once GL entries post.
resolution_notes:
Workaround/mitigation: DevInfra increased table capacity and re-ran the ledger-sync job which restored mappings for the 7 vendors. Finance executed manual payments on 2026-03-01; those payments were reconciled against bank statements on 2026-03-05.
Permanent fix: Engineering to add explicit failure alerts to ledger-sync (notify #finance and create INC when mapping writes fail), and update payrun-service to surface 'mapping_error' items on finance console instead of silently excluding. PR for improved payrun logging submitted (PR 1420).
Status: Temporary mitigation applied and payrun behavior corrected for this run; follow-up engineering work scheduled (see follow_up_tasks).
follow_up_tasks: ENG-Task: Add error propagation and alerting in ledger-sync pipeline (owner: Marcus Nguyen) — target 2026-03-12.
ENG-Task: Update payrun-service to surface mapping_error vendors in finance console and create a review queue (owner: Payments team) — target 2026-03-19.
FIN-Task: Reconciliation checklist update to include 'mapping_missing' audit after each automated payrun (owner: Elena Park) — target 2026-03-10.
OPS-Task: Database shard capacity monitoring to prevent write deadlocks; add autoscaling policy (owner: DevInfra) — target 2026-03-08.
